title: Matched o-initial words occur farther right than qo-initial counterparts
statement: Within paragraph-line interiors, certain o-initial word forms occur farther right on average than their matched qo-initial variants with the same remaining spelling. The comparison weights tokens and requires the lower 95% page-bootstrap bound on the difference to exceed zero.
source: Patrick Feaster, Rightward and Downward Grapheme Distributions in the Voynich Manuscript, section 3 and Table 2 (https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-3313/paper12.pdf). Matching and sampling use the approved implementation in https://github.com/Ayan-Bandyopadhyay/voynich-swarm/pull/708 .
